For a soy sauce substitute in a stir-fry that maintains the savory, umami profile while being soy-free, you can use **Coconut Aminos**. It has a similar salty-savory flavor but is slightly sweeter and less salty than traditional soy sauce. Another option is **Tamari** if the allergy is strictly to soy protein but not gluten, though many soy-allergic individuals also react to tamari, so Coconut Aminos is the safer bet for a strict soy allergy. You can also use a mix of **beef or mushroom broth** with a splash of **balsamic vinegar** or **molasses** to mimic the depth and color.
